about.founderHeading: "NIDA" — An Enduring Name Born From Vision
about.founderP1: The brand name "Nida" is crafted to be pronounced gracefully as both "Nee-da" and "Ni-da", honoring founder Phannida whose passion for classic American collegiate tailoring meets contemporary ease in every walk of life.
about.founderP2: Nida has blossomed into a complete Lifestyle Destination spanning tailored apparel, fine leather goods, footwear, and home living objects — unified by our signature Yellow, Brown, and White tri-color ribbon emblem symbolizing warmth, integrity, and optimism.

about.value3Desc: A holistic destination for apparel, fine leather, footwear, and mindful home objects.
